title: The night Roman Bellic lost everything in GTA 4
subject: roman
description:
Did you ever say yes to bowling? 👇

Behind the meme, Roman Bellic was the one Dimitri Rascalov came after first. Spoilers for Grand Theft Auto IV.

scenes.text: Let's go bowling. Millions of players remember Roman for that phone call.
The calls came mid-chase, mid-shootout, and fans turned them into a meme.
Then Dimitri Rascalov betrayed Niko and went after Roman.
In the mission Hostile Negotiation, Dimitri's men kidnapped him. Niko had to fight his way in to get him out.
Soon after, in Roman's Sorrow, they burned his apartment and his taxi depot.
Everything Roman had built in Broker was gone in one night.
Every bowling invite after that came from a man who had already lost it all once.
